name: Puncture Veil
body:
School evocation; Level sorcerer/wizard 1, witch 1, witchwarper 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action; see text
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target one or two creatures; see text
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You grasp onto an alternate reality filled with microscopic needles and use them to pierce into your reality. One creature takes 1d4 piercing damage and gains 1 bleed damage for 1 round/level (maximum 5 rounds).

You can cast this spell as a full-round action. If you do, you have two options. You can target two creatures within 20 feet of each other with the effect described above.

Alternatively, you can target only one creature, who takes 2d4 piercing damage and gains 2 bleed damage for 1 round/level (maximum 5 rounds).
